findings.mechanism: Unknown cost/energy/distance is zeroed; blended denominator includes all energy while numerator includes only known prices. findings.dedup: Existing audit-page-086 unknown-as-zero root; forecast nullable-leaf chart site is an additional mechanism under the same root, not another finding.

findings.mechanism: distanceAddedM from charging-curve/helpers.ts:27-30 uses end_odometer_m minus start_odometer_m DURING charging, not distance driven between charges or energy-added range.
